Built **Little Acre**, a complete, touch-friendly pocket farming game in `index.html`.

Plant and water crops, advance the day to grow them, harvest and sell produce, buy seeds, and progress through four seasons. Your farm and inventory save in the browser. I assumed each season lasts seven days and crops grow on days they’re watered.

Verified the planting, watering, growth, harvesting, and season-change loop in the browser, and checked the mobile layout.
